billing.faq49Q1: Kodi kuyesa kwaulere kwa masiku 7 kumagwira ntchito bwanji?
billing.faq49A1: Mukamaliza kugula muyenera kutsimikizira khadi yanu yakubanki kudzera pa Stripe — ndikofunikira, koma palibe chomwe chimachotsedwa kwa masiku 7 ndipo mumapeza mwayi wathunthu. Kuyesa kukatha, €49/mwezi imachotsedwa yokha. Letsani musanathe masiku 7 ndipo simudzachotsedwa chilichonse.
billing.faq49A2: Autopilot shell: kufufuza ndi kusanthula zomwe zikuchitika, kuyang'anira omvera, UGC studio, Chrome extension, Publisher ndi ndondomeko ya zinthu, autopilot ndi Gallery. AI generation yokha siyikuphatikizidwa — imayenda kudzera pa zolembetsa zanu (Google Flow, NotebookLM, HeyGen) kapena makiyi anu a API, ndipo mumalipira opereka chithandizo molunjika pa mitengo yawo.
billing.faq49Q3: Nchifukwa chiyani zolembetsa ndi zotsika mtengo kuposa API?
billing.faq49A3: Opereka chithandizo amagulitsa ngongole zolembetsa zotsika mtengo kwambiri kuposa masekondi omwewo kudzera pa API: Veo pa zolembetsa za Google AI ndi zotsika mtengo 2–10×, ma avatar a HeyGen pafupifupi 3× zotsika mtengo. Ndipo NotebookLM ilibe API yotseguka konse — zolembetsa zokha. Extension imachita zokha ntchito mkati mwa maakaunti anu, kukupatsani mwayi wofanana ndi API pa mitengo yolembetsa. Manambala enieni ali mu tebulo ndi chowerengera pamwambapa.
billing.faq49A4: Ziwiri ndizokwanira kuyamba: Google AI Pro (€21.99/mwezi — Flow video + NotebookLM yokhala ndi malire apamwamba) ndi HeyGen Creator ($29/mwezi — pafupifupi mphindi 30 za Avatar IV). Ntchito iliyonse ilinso ndi malire aulere (Flow — 50 credits/tsiku, NotebookLM — 3 overviews/tsiku, HeyGen — 3 mavidiyo/mwezi), kotero mutha kuyesa pipeline popanda zolembetsa konse.
billing.faq49Q5: Kodi ndingagwire ntchito ndi makiyi a API okha?
billing.faq49A5: Inde. Lumikizani makiyi anu (Google Veo, FAL/Kling, Runway, OpenAI, ElevenLabs, HeyGen, Claude) mu Zokonda ndipo ntchitoyo imapanga nawo molunjika, palibe extension yofunikira. Mumalipira ntchitozo pa mitengo yawo. Njira zimasakanikirana momasuka: ma avatar pa zolembetsa, voice-over kudzera pa API, mwachitsanzo.
billing.faq49Q6: Kodi ndimathetsa bwanji? Batani lili kuti?
billing.faq49A6: Pamwamba pa tsamba lino, mu khadi la “Dongosolo lanu”, batani la “Zimitsa kukonzanso zokha” limawonekera pamene kulembetsa kukugwira ntchito. Nthawi zolipiridwa sizibwezeredwa, koma mwayi umakhalapo mpaka nthawi itatha. Zimitsani panthawi yoyeserera ndipo simudzalipidwa konse. Mutha kuyambiranso ndi kudina kamodzi nthawi iliyonse nthawi isanathe.

landing.featIntro: VibeVox imagwira ntchito mwachindunji mu msakatuli wanu. landing.featRolloverText: Ndalama zosagwiritsidwa ntchito zimapita kumwezi wotsatira. Mukalipira, mphindi ndi zanu popanda tsiku lomaliza.

landing.featVoiceText: Mawu a HD Aoede ndi Charon. Gemini amamasulira mawu mwachindunji kumawu — palibe STT→text→TTS chain. Kuchedwa kosakwana 0.5 sekondi, kukambirana kumayenda bwino.

landing.finalSub: Lembetsani mu mphindi imodzi. Masiku 7 oyambirira ndi aulere.

landing.hintsText: Mu SIP telephony, AI imalemba zokambirana nthawi yomweyo ndikuwonetsa mayankho okonzeka kwa manejala. Pambuyo pa kuyimba — zovuta, zoyambitsa, ndi ma tag zimapita ku CRM (Chatwoot, Questflow) zokha. Lumikizani ku Zadarma, Twilio, ndi SIP gateway iliyonse.
landing.langsText: Inu mumalankhula chilankhulo chanu — omwe mumalumikizana nawo amamva kumasulira kwawo. Iwo amayankha — inu mumawamva nthawi yomweyo mu {{lang}}. Mwachidule, popanda kuchedwa, popanda kamvekedwe.

ttLanding.f1Text: Santhulani mapulatifomu atatu ndi niche ndi dera. "Kuyang'anira omvera": fotokozani chinthu chanu — AI idzadzaza okha omvera, kusankha mawu osakira m'zilankhulo 29, ndikupeza ma niches omwe ali ndi kufunikira kwenikweni. Ma channel a opikisana nawo mu watchlist ndi mbiri ya metrics.
ttLanding.f2Text: Ikani ulalo wa vidiyo iliyonse ya TikTok, Instagram, kapena YouTube — Gemini idzaiphwanya chimango ndi chimango: hook, rhythm, structure, captions. Kuphwanya ndi ma subtitles zidzapita ku gallery, ndipo "TrendDNA" idzatsogolera okha vidiyo yanu yamtsogolo.
ttLanding.f2Title: Chinsinsi cha virality — chimango ndi chimango
ttLanding.f3Text: Mitundu inayi: solo, zokambirana za anthu awiri, mawu anu "monga ali", kutsogolera kutengera kusanthula kwa zochitika. Maonekedwe okonzeka a HeyGen kapena avatar kuchokera pa chithunzi chanu, mawu onse a ElevenLabs kuphatikiza ma clones, masitayelo a subtitle amoyo, ndi zida zamtundu.
ttLanding.f4Text: Kuyang'anira zochitika kumasandutsa zopezeka kukhala mavidiyo okonzeka kutengera template yanu. Maunyolo ofalitsa okha amagawira okha ma formats pa mapulatifomu ndi malo — TikTok, YouTube, ndi Instagram amalandira zinthu pa nthawi yake.

ttLanding.savBody: Chrome extension yathu imalumikiza ntchito za AI pogwiritsa ntchito ma subscription anu omwe alipo m'malo molipira ma API credit. Ndipo makiyi anu (BYOK) — Gemini, ElevenLabs, TikHub, Blotato — amagwira ntchito mwachindunji, popanda zowonjezera zapakati.
ttLanding.stBody: Kufufuza zochitika, kuwunika mavidiyo otchuka, ma avatar, mawu, mawu ang'onoang'ono, mavidiyo opangidwa okha, ndi kutumiza okha—zonse pamalo amodzi. Lumikizani makiyi anu a ntchito kapena zolembetsa ndikulipira m'njira yotsika mtengo kwambiri kwa inu.

ttLanding.step1Text: Chosanthula chathu chimayang'ana TikTok, Instagram, ndi YouTube kutengera niche yanu, dera, ndi chilankhulo. AI yathu imazindikira ma micro-niches ndi mawu osakira, kuwayika motsatira kufunikira kwenikweni.
ttLanding.step2Text: Kusanthula kwa Gemini kumawunika mavidiyo otchuka kukhala zokoka, nyimbo, ndi kapangidwe. Mumapeza TrendDNA—chinsinsi cha studio yanu yamavidiyo, kuphatikiza mawu ang'onoang'ono oyambirira.
ttLanding.step3Text: Studio yathu ya UGC imapanga mavidiyo a AI avatar: mawonekedwe okonzeka kapena avatar kuchokera pa chithunzi chanu, mawu a ElevenLabs m'zilankhulo 29, zocheka, mawu ang'onoang'ono, ndi zida zamtundu. Mawonekedwe 9:16 ndi 16:9.
ttLanding.step4Text: Autopilot imayang'anira zochitika ndikusonkhanitsa mavidiyo pogwiritsa ntchito ma template, pomwe Publisher amawakonzekeretsa masiku 35 pasadakhale: 9:16 ya TikTok, 16:9 ya YouTube.

ttLanding.sbB1: Mtsogoleri wa AI amakonza zokamba kukhala mapanelo — inu mumangosintha storyboard pa filimu
ttLanding.sbB2: Ma injini atatu opangira: mapulogalamu (aulere, opanda makiyi), Omni API, kapena Google Flow ndi kulembetsa kwanu
ttLanding.sbB3: Kukonza zokha: mzere wopanga umangoyenda wokha, kusonkhanitsa kokha kumalumikiza Reel yomalizidwa popanda inu
ttLanding.sbB4: Mawu a CTA kumapeto: owonera amayankha — kuchita nawo kumawonjezera kufikira
ttLanding.sbBody: Mitu yolankhula yosasintha imadutsa m'masekondi — zithunzi zosinthasintha zokha ndizo zimakopa chidwi. Storyboard imasonkhanitsanso kujambula kwanu kukhala Reel yosinthasintha: imalemba zokamba, imadula kukhala mawu mpaka masekondi 8, ndikukonza chilichonse kukhala mapanelo — wokamba nkhani wapafupi, mitu yodzaza chophimba, zodulidwa, zowonera ziwiri, zitsanzo, ndi kutha kwa kuyitanira kuchitapo kanthu.

storyboard.asmIntro: Zigawo zomalizidwa zimasonkhanitsidwa motsatira, ndi chizindikiro pamwamba komanso (ngati mukufuna) mawu omasulira. Zotsatira zake zimapita ku Gallery → "Mafayilo a media" ndipo zakonzeka kwa Wofalitsa.
storyboard.costNote: Injini ya pulogalamuyi sigwiritsa ntchito makiyi akunja. Kulemba — pempho limodzi la Gemini; dongosolo la AI panel — pempho limodzi la Claude (makiyi mu Zokonda).

storyboard.genIntro: Njira yoyendetsera ntchito: chigawo 1 choyamba. Yang'anani zotsatira — zina zonse zidzatsegulidwa. Injini ya pulogalamuyi imakonza ndi ma panel: zooms, mitu, zoyika, split-screen.

storyboard.pickerNote: Vidiyo yolankhula: 9:16 yoyima, masekondi 15–60, mawu omveka. Maulalo a TikTok/IG/YouTube akhoza kutsitsidwa kuchokera ku tabu ya "Trends" → "By link."
storyboard.pngHint: Yang'anani mwachidwi: mawu alibe zolakwika, mafelemu ndi anu — ndikotsika mtengo kupeza zolakwika pano kuposa pambuyo pa kupanga.
storyboard.replanHint: Panganinso ma panel a zigawo zonse ndi AI director (kusintha kwa mawu pamanja kudzachotsedwa)
storyboard.srcHint: Gwero limasintha popanga polojekiti. Ngati mukufuna take yosiyana, pangani storyboard yatsopano kuchokera ku Gallery.
storyboard.tabIntro: Kukonza zokha Reels kuchokera ku vidiyo yolankhula: lembani → storyboard yokhala ndi ma panel 6 pa chigawo chilichonse → pangani ndikusonkhanitsa. Tengani take yanu kuchokera ku Gallery kapena kweza kuchokera pa chipangizo chanu.
storyboard.trChunks: Zigawo zadulidwa: {{n}} (kumapeto kwa mawu, mpaka masekondi 8). Kenako — gawo 3 "Storyboard."
storyboard.trIntro: Gemini imasanthula vidiyo yonse: mawu enieni ndi nthawi + zochitika zenizeni. Kenako vidiyoyo imadulidwa m'zigawo zosapitirira masekondi 8 kumapeto kwa mawu, ndipo storyboard imapangidwa pa chilichonse.
storyboard.trNoAiHint: Palibe kiyi ya Gemini: ngakhale zigawo za 8s, mapanelo a template
storyboard.stripHint: Chunk filmstrip. Dinani furemu kuti muyike ku paneli yosankhidwa (yomwe ilipo: {{n}}). Sankhani paneli podina khadi yake kapena mzere wamitundu.
storyboard.attachNote: Sankhani kanema wosungidwa ndi chowonjezera kuchokera ku Google Flow ("To Gallery"). Tidzasintha kukhala mtundu wa chunk ndikuyika mawu oyambirira.
storyboard.genIntroFlow: Flow engine (semi-auto): tsitsani zida za chunk, pangani mu Google Flow (Omni Flash, 9:16, "sungani mawu oyambirira"), sungani kanema "To Gallery" ndi chowonjezera — ndikuyika pano. Tidzayika mawu a chunk tokha.
storyboard.genIntroOmni: Omni Flash engine: kupanga kamodzi pa chunk — furemu yoyambira "imakhala yamoyo" malinga ndi prompt ya paneli, ndi mawu anu oyambirira oyikidwa. Mtengo ≈$1/chunk (~10s × $0.10) kuchokera ku kiyi yanu ya Gemini. Chunk 1 choyamba!
storyboard.autoAssemble: Pangani vidiyo yokha pamene zigawo zonse zakwanira
storyboard.flowActiveHint: Flow queue ikugwira ntchito — sungani tabu ya labs.google/…/flow yotseguka. Ma status amasintha okha.
storyboard.flowQueueAll: Zokha: tumizani zigawo zonse ku Flow
storyboard.genIntroFlow2: Flow engine — ZOKHA: tsegulani labs.google → Flow mu msakatuli wanu ndi chowonjezera cha TrendTraffic ndikudina batani ili pansipa. Chowonjezera chidzakweza zokha chunk ndi storyboard, kuyika prompt, kupanga, ndikubweza kanema — chunk ndi chunk, ngakhale pa vidiyo yayitali (Flow limit ~8s/clip, ndichifukwa chake timadula mpaka 8s). Tidzayika mawu oyambirira tokha. Njira yamanja — mabatani pa makhadi.
